verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents general coding-agent sessions that can be triggered from CI or scripts, and it can open draft pull requests on request. Nothing in the evidence shows it ingesting security alerts, validating them, or remediating them automatically into an opened PR. These are building blocks a team could wire together, not the documented capability, so the story earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request

citations.quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
Draft PR creation — Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
